lastTouched: 2026-10-03 set 8 landed as docs/vis-set-08 (17 documents: 16 scheduled plus CAL-GLOBE-00001, an instrument). The sphere winding bug behind F-024/F-028/F-029 is fixed. Set 8 is NOT device-verified - the player stopped staying up mid-session.

findings.summary: rc2json cannot read documents containing 3D ops (Unknown opcode 91)
rcj vs Java oracle differ up to 19x on 3D; defineMesh3D geometry is dropped by the Java writer AND the two renders differ visibly; jsonReproduces says yes for all five anyway
touchExpression's string expression is dropped by the Java parser, which wants an RPN float array; delta is 4 B per RPN token
alpha on a 3D mesh does not blend in the C++ player; meshes render opaque
corpus teaches text component syntax rcj rejects; 201 of 636 are unsupported
panX 0.0 centres rather than left-aligns; every set-1 title was clipped
coverage.json opcode table has no 3D names; 3D usage invisible
a wrongly wound defineMesh3D mesh renders as nothing, with no error anywhere
wireframe meshes write depth across whole faces, occluding their contents
a texture is invisible on a wireframe mesh; a 3D surface can be see-through or textured, not both
rcx round-trip ignored base_dir, mislabelling any document with a bitmap asset
a sized canvas component does not clip its drawing; 2D and 3D both escape over siblings
nested 3D projects into the document viewport offset by the component, not into the component
the Java JSON parser has no 3D commands at all and drops them silently; the oracle gate was vacuous for 16 of 80 documents
rc2json decodes only 2 of 7 3D ops and loses stream sync; no structural 3D verifier exists on the desktop
stopMode is a no-op in rcj and unknown to the Java parser, which reads touchMode
3D opcodes are from unlanded CL ag/4108133; no 3D runs on this APK. Cadence continues - C++ and TS players support 3D
rcdev's oracle fallback silently shipped a 3D document with its 3D removed and reported OK; base_dir was also unset so every textured document hit it
the clock WAS pinnable via --time; the bug was a >0 guard that made --time 0 silently not pin. Added --clock; corrects two earlier conclusions
textFromFloat renders 0 for a numeric literal value; it must be a string. No gate catches it
clipRect intersects and cannot be widened; a reset is a no-op. Scoped to a canvas component. Broke three documents in set 6
rcj writes expressions over the 32-token cap that the Java writer refuses and a device would reject; only the oracle byte delta catches it
rand() is not pinned by --clock, so no particle document reproduced; added rc2image --seed
texture v runs bottom-to-top; the u mirroring reported here was an artefact of the inside-out sphere (F-029), not a player convention
a great circle over ~110 degrees reads as a line through the globe; C++ and TS agree to 0.1 mean diff, so it was never a player divergence
claimed the sphere UV convention was solved by calibration; superseded by F-028, which shows route placement still disagrees
a thin tube mesh is not occluded by a sphere even when deep inside it; splitting, draw order and texture all ruled out. Worked around by raising the arcs
route/texture mismatch: root cause was the inside-out sphere winding (F-029)
CORRECTED: no engine defect. uv_sphere was wound inside out, so the player drew the inner far hemisphere - mirrored and counter-rotating
a file-named bitmap makes a document non-self-contained and the JS converter refuses it; base64 fixes it with a byte-identical .rc. Sets 2 and 5 still need converting
